```{r}
# read scaled coefficients
loadings <- read.delim("scaledLoadingsCoefficients.txt")
dim(loadings)

# choose those metabolites from MV2 and MV6 with cutoff of 3

mv2_loadings_nna <- cbind(rownames(loadings)[which(!is.na(loadings$MV5))], loadings$MV5[which(!is.na(loadings$MV5))])
dim(mv2_loadings_nna)

mv2_loadings_nna_unk <- cbind(mv2_loadings_nna[-grep("unknown", mv2_loadings_nna[,1], ignore.case = TRUE),1],
                              mv2_loadings_nna[-grep("unknown", mv2_loadings_nna[,1], ignore.case = TRUE),2])
dim(mv2_loadings_nna_unk)

mv2_loadings_nna_unk_sig <- cbind(
  mv2_loadings_nna_unk[(as.numeric(mv2_loadings_nna_unk[,2]) > 2 | as.numeric(mv2_loadings_nna_unk[,2]) < -2),1],
  mv2_loadings_nna_unk[(as.numeric(mv2_loadings_nna_unk[,2]) > 2 | as.numeric(mv2_loadings_nna_unk[,2]) < -2),2]
)
dim(mv2_loadings_nna_unk_sig)

```

```{r}
# read metabolomics data
metab <- read.delim("20200902_ColossusResults_Metabolomics_2_tissue_weight_Centre_run_batch_corrected_data.txt", 
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dim(metab)
```

```{r}
# match metabolites between metabolic dataset and mv loadings
known <- unique(c(mv2_loadings_nna_unk_sig[,1]))
metabolites <- metab$Metabolites

# safe parsing function
parse_entry_safe <- function(entry) {
  entry <- iconv(entry, to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(entry, "_"))
  if (length(parts) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  name <- paste0(parts[1:(length(parts) - 2)], collapse = "_")
  mass <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[length(parts) - 1]))
  rt <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[length(parts)]))
  
  if (is.na(mass) || is.na(rt)) return(NULL)
  
  return(list(
    original = entry,
    name = gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", name),
    mass = mass,
    rt = rt
  ))
}

known_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(known, parse_entry_safe))
metabolites_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(metabolites, parse_entry_safe))

known_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, known_list), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
metabolites_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, metabolites_list), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

known_df$mass <- as.numeric(known_df$mass)
known_df$rt <- as.numeric(known_df$rt)
metabolites_df$mass <- as.numeric(metabolites_df$mass)
metabolites_df$rt <- as.numeric(metabolites_df$rt)

delta_mass <- 0.02
delta_rt <- 0.1

matched_indices <- sapply(1:nrow(known_df), function(i) {
  matches <- which(abs(known_df$mass[i] - metabolites_df$mass) <= delta_mass &
                   abs(known_df$rt[i] - metabolites_df$rt) <= delta_rt)
  if (length(matches) > 0) return(matches[1]) else return(NA)
})

matched_indices <- matched_indices[!is.na(matched_indices)]
matched_indices <- unique(matched_indices)

print(matched_indices)

head(metab[matched_indices, 1:5])

metab_matched <- metab[matched_indices, ]
dim(metab_matched)
```

```{r}
# clinical data
clin <- read.delim("20250426_VHIO_retrospective_clinical_PNI_Lym_RFS_PNI_NA_removed.txt", 
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dim(clin)

m_clin <- match(gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(metab_matched)[-1]), clin$COLOSSUS_ID)
w_clin <- which(!is.na(m_clin))

clin_1 <- clin[m_clin[w_clin], ]
dim(clin_1)

colnames(mmet) <- metab_matched[,1]

metab_clin <- cbind(clin_1, sample_id = colnames(metab_matched)[(w_clin + 1)], mmet)
dim(metab_clin)

# keep same object name used later in script
metab_clin_sel <- metab_clin

# convert PNI to binary
metab_clin_sel$PNI <- ifelse(tolower(trimws(metab_clin_sel$perineural_invasion)) == "yes", 1, 0)
```


```{r}
# proteins ~ PNI + metabolites with stratified 70/30 train-test validation
# Models with perfect separation are excluded
set.seed(121)

protein_exp <- read.delim("20200803_Colossus_RPPA_datasheet_June15_normalized_data_Jochen.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = 1)

dim(protein_exp)

# keep only proteins with SD > 0
protein_numeric <- protein_exp
protein_numeric[, -1] <- lapply(protein_numeric[, -1, drop = FALSE], as.numeric)

ssdp <- apply(protein_numeric[, -1, drop = FALSE], 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
w_ssdp <- which(ssdp > 0.5)
length(w_ssdp)

protein_exp_sd <- protein_numeric[w_ssdp, ]
dim(protein_exp_sd)

# 1. Transpose protein matrix: make samples rows, proteins columns
protein_long <- as.data.frame(t(protein_exp_sd))
protein_long$sample_id <- rownames(protein_long)

# 2. Fix sample ID format to match metab_clin_sel$COLOSSUS_ID
# If protein colnames are like COL.268.R.001_FP_001, convert to COL-268-R-001
protein_long$COLOSSUS_ID <- substr(gsub("\\.", "-", protein_long$sample_id), 1, 13)

# metabolites
#selected_mets <- c(
 # "(S)-2-Methylbutanoic acid",
  #"2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_2.84",
 # "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.42",
  #"4-Ethyloctanoic acid",
  #"Fumaric acid",
  #"Butyric acid",
  #"Galactitol",
#  "Hydrocinnamic acid",
 # "Ketoleucine",
  #"Palmitic acid",
  #"Taurine",
  #"Undecanoic acid"
#)

selected_mets <- c(
  "Butyric acid_88.05_3.29",
  #"(S)-2-Methylbutanoic acid_102.07_3.09",
  #"2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.42",
  "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.59",
  #"Ketoleucine_130.06_2.98",
  "2-Methylbenzoic acid_136.05_3.07",
 # "Hydrocinnamic acid_150.07_2.96",
  "4-Ethyloctanoic acid_172.15_2.92",
  "Galactitol_182.08_12.08"#,
  #"Palmitic acid_256.24_2.91"
)

colnames(metab_clin_sel) <- iconv(colnames(metab_clin_sel), to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
selected_mets <- iconv(selected_mets, to = "UTF-8", sub = "")

met_cols <- unlist(lapply(selected_mets, function(x) {
  grep(
    paste0("^", gsub("([][{}()+*^$.|\\\\?])", "\\\\\\1", x), "$|^",
           gsub("([][{}()+*^$.|\\\\?])", "\\\\\\1", x), "_"),
    colnames(metab_clin_sel),
    value = TRUE
  )
}))
met_cols <- unique(met_cols)

# merge
combined_data <- merge(
  protein_long,
  metab_clin_sel[, c("COLOSSUS_ID", "PNI", met_cols), drop = FALSE],
  by = "COLOSSUS_ID"
)

dim(combined_data)

# make sure PNI is numeric 0/1
combined_data$PNI <- as.numeric(as.character(combined_data$PNI))

table(combined_data$PNI)

protein_names <- setdiff(colnames(protein_long), c("sample_id", "COLOSSUS_ID"))
metabolite_names <- met_cols

model_grid <- expand.grid(
  protein = protein_names,
  metabolite = metabolite_names,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# parameters
n_iter <- 100
p_thresh <- 0.05

all_results_list <- list()

skip_counts <- c(
  too_few_rows = 0,
  single_pni_class = 0,
  train_model_fail = 0,
  test_model_fail = 0,
  perfect_fit_train = 0,
  perfect_fit_test = 0,
  no_interaction_train = 0,
  no_interaction_test = 0,
  non_finite_interaction_train = 0,
  non_finite_interaction_test = 0
)

for (i in 1:n_iter) {
  cat("Iteration:", i, "\n")
  
  # stratified split by PNI
  idx_pni0 <- which(combined_data$PNI == 0)
  idx_pni1 <- which(combined_data$PNI == 1)
  
  n_train0 <- max(2, floor(0.7 * length(idx_pni0)))
  n_train1 <- max(2, floor(0.7 * length(idx_pni1)))
  
  train_idx0 <- sample(idx_pni0, size = n_train0, replace = FALSE)
  train_idx1 <- sample(idx_pni1, size = n_train1, replace = FALSE)
  
  train_idx <- c(train_idx0, train_idx1)
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(combined_data)), train_idx)
  
  train_data <- combined_data[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  test_data  <- combined_data[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  iter_results <- list()
  
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(model_grid))) {
    protein <- model_grid$protein[j]
    metabolite <- model_grid$metabolite[j]
    
    # training data
    df_train <- train_data[, c(protein, "PNI", metabolite), drop = FALSE]
    colnames(df_train) <- c("protein_val", "PNI", "met_val")
    
    df_train$protein_val <- as.numeric(df_train$protein_val)
    df_train$PNI <- as.numeric(df_train$PNI)
    df_train$met_val <- as.numeric(df_train$met_val)
    
    df_train <- df_train[
      complete.cases(df_train) &
        is.finite(df_train$protein_val) &
        is.finite(df_train$met_val),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    
    # test data
    df_test <- test_data[, c(protein, "PNI", metabolite), drop = FALSE]
    colnames(df_test) <- c("protein_val", "PNI", "met_val")
    
    df_test$protein_val <- as.numeric(df_test$protein_val)
    df_test$PNI <- as.numeric(df_test$PNI)
    df_test$met_val <- as.numeric(df_test$met_val)
    
    df_test <- df_test[
      complete.cases(df_test) &
        is.finite(df_test$protein_val) &
        is.finite(df_test$met_val),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    
    if (nrow(df_train) <= 4 || nrow(df_test) <= 4) {
      skip_counts["too_few_rows"] <- skip_counts["too_few_rows"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    if (length(unique(df_train$PNI)) < 2 || length(unique(df_test$PNI)) < 2) {
      skip_counts["single_pni_class"] <- skip_counts["single_pni_class"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    model_train <- tryCatch(
      lm(protein_val ~ PNI * met_val, data = df_train),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(model_train)) {
      skip_counts["train_model_fail"] <- skip_counts["train_model_fail"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    model_test <- tryCatch(
      lm(protein_val ~ PNI * met_val, data = df_test),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(model_test)) {
      skip_counts["test_model_fail"] <- skip_counts["test_model_fail"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    sm_train <- summary(model_train)
    sm_test  <- summary(model_test)
    
    # remove perfect / saturated / unusable fits
    if (df.residual(model_train) <= 0 ||
        !is.finite(sm_train$r.squared) ||
        sm_train$r.squared >= 0.9999) {
      skip_counts["perfect_fit_train"] <- skip_counts["perfect_fit_train"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    if (df.residual(model_test) <= 0 ||
        !is.finite(sm_test$r.squared) ||
        sm_test$r.squared >= 0.9999) {
      skip_counts["perfect_fit_test"] <- skip_counts["perfect_fit_test"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    summ_train <- sm_train$coefficients
    summ_test  <- sm_test$coefficients
    
    if (!("PNI:met_val" %in% rownames(summ_train))) {
      skip_counts["no_interaction_train"] <- skip_counts["no_interaction_train"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    if (!("PNI:met_val" %in% rownames(summ_test))) {
      skip_counts["no_interaction_test"] <- skip_counts["no_interaction_test"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    est_train  <- summ_train["PNI:met_val", "Estimate"]
    pval_train <- summ_train["PNI:met_val", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    r2_train   <- sm_train$r.squared
    
    est_test  <- summ_test["PNI:met_val", "Estimate"]
    pval_test <- summ_test["PNI:met_val", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    r2_test   <- sm_test$r.squared
    
    if (!is.finite(est_train) || !is.finite(pval_train)) {
      skip_counts["non_finite_interaction_train"] <- skip_counts["non_finite_interaction_train"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    if (!is.finite(est_test) || !is.finite(pval_test)) {
      skip_counts["non_finite_interaction_test"] <- skip_counts["non_finite_interaction_test"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    sig_train <- ifelse(!is.na(pval_train) && pval_train < p_thresh, 1, 0)
    sig_test  <- ifelse(!is.na(pval_test) && pval_test < p_thresh, 1, 0)
    
    same_sign <- ifelse(
      !is.na(est_train) && !is.na(est_test) && sign(est_train) == sign(est_test),
      1, 0
    )
    
    validated_direction <- ifelse(sig_train == 1 && same_sign == 1, 1, 0)
    validated_strict    <- ifelse(sig_train == 1 && sig_test == 1 && same_sign == 1, 1, 0)
    
    iter_results[[length(iter_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      iteration = i,
      protein = protein,
      metabolite = metabolite,
      estimate_train = est_train,
      pval_train = pval_train,
      r2_train = r2_train,
      estimate_test = est_test,
      pval_test = pval_test,
      r2_test = r2_test,
      significant_train = sig_train,
      significant_test = sig_test,
      same_sign = same_sign,
      validated_direction = validated_direction,
      validated_strict = validated_strict,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if (length(iter_results) > 0) {
    all_results_list[[length(all_results_list) + 1]] <- do.call(rbind, iter_results)
  }
}

all_results <- do.call(rbind, all_results_list)

if (is.null(all_results) || nrow(all_results) == 0) {
  stop("No valid train-test interaction results were generated. Inspect skip_counts.")
}

summary_stats <- all_results %>%
  group_by(protein, metabolite) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested = n(),
    n_train_hits = sum(significant_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_test_hits = sum(significant_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_same_sign = sum(same_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_validated_direction = sum(validated_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_validated_strict = sum(validated_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_train = mean(significant_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_test = mean(significant_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_same_sign = mean(same_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_validated_direction = mean(validated_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_validated_strict = mean(validated_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_estimate_train = mean(estimate_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_estimate_train = median(estimate_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_estimate_test = mean(estimate_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_estimate_test = median(estimate_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pval_train = mean(pval_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pval_train = median(pval_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pval_test = mean(pval_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pval_test = median(pval_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2_train = mean(r2_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2_test = mean(r2_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frequency_validated_direction),
          desc(frequency_train),
          median_pval_train)

print(skip_counts)
print(summary_stats)

# recommended primary hits:
summary_stats_sig <- summary_stats %>%
  filter(frequency_train >= 0.6,
         frequency_validated_direction >= 0.6) %>%
  arrange(desc(frequency_validated_direction),
          desc(frequency_train),
          median_pval_train)

print(summary_stats_sig)
length(unique(summary_stats_sig$protein))
```

```{r}
  positive_hits <- summary_stats_sig %>%
    filter(median_estimate_train > 0,

} else {
```

```{r}
#density plot
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: FDR adjustment
positive_hits <- positive_hits %>%
  mutate(pval_fdr = p.adjust(median_pval_train, method = "fdr"))

# Step 2: Select top 20 by raw p-value
top_20 <- positive_hits %>%
  arrange(median_pval_train) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

# Step 3: Add all interactions involving FAK or PDK1
# Replace with correct IDs if needed (e.g., Q05397 for FAK, Q15118 for PDK1)
target_proteins <- c("FAK", "PDK1(S241)")
target_rows <- positive_hits %>%
  filter(protein %in% target_proteins)

# Combine and remove duplicates
plot_data <- bind_rows(top_20, target_rows) %>%
  distinct(protein, metabolite, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    interaction = paste(protein, metabolite, sep = " × "),
    neg_log_fdr = -log10(pval_fdr)
  )

# Step 4: Plot
#pdf("20250512_COLOSSUS_PNI_metabolites_protein_1000_iterations_density_plot_RPPA_Data_bubble_plot.pdf")
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(interaction, neg_log_fdr), y = neg_log_fdr)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = neg_log_fdr, color = median_pval_train), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 10)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#2166AC", high = "#FEE090", trans = "log",
                       name = "Raw p-value", labels = scales::scientific) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Interactions + FAK and PDK1",
    subtitle = "Color = raw p-value; Size = −log10(FDR-adjusted p-value)",
    x = "Protein × Metabolite",
    y = expression("-log"[10]*"(FDR-adjusted p-value)")
  )
#dev.off()


```


```{r}

## =========================================================
## Clean Train vs Test scatter plot with correct labelling
## =========================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)
library(scales)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Output directory
## ---------------------------------------------------------
out_dir_main <- "5I_J"
dir.create(out_dir_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Check required objects
## ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("summary_stats"))
stopifnot(exists("summary_stats_sig"))

required_cols_summary <- c(
  "protein", "metabolite",
  "mean_estimate_train", "mean_estimate_test",
  "median_pval_train",
  "frequency_train", "frequency_validated_direction"
)

missing_summary <- setdiff(required_cols_summary, colnames(summary_stats))
if (length(missing_summary) > 0) {
  stop("summary_stats is missing required columns: ",
       paste(missing_summary, collapse = ", "))
}

required_cols_sig <- c("protein", "metabolite")
missing_sig <- setdiff(required_cols_sig, colnames(summary_stats_sig))
if (length(missing_sig) > 0) {
  stop("summary_stats_sig is missing required columns: ",
       paste(missing_sig, collapse = ", "))
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Helper functions for metabolite labels
## ---------------------------------------------------------
extract_metabolite_parts <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- iconv(x, to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(x, "_", fixed = TRUE))

  if (length(parts) >= 3) {
    list(
      name = paste(parts[1:(length(parts) - 2)], collapse = "_"),
      mass = parts[length(parts) - 1],
      rt   = parts[length(parts)]
    )
  } else {
    list(
      name = x,
      mass = NA_character_,
      rt   = NA_character_
    )
  }
}

clean_metabolite_name <- function(x) {
  p <- extract_metabolite_parts(x)
  nm <- p$name
  nm <- gsub("^X\\.*", "", nm)
  nm <- gsub("\\.", " ", nm)
  nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm)
  nm <- gsub("\\s+", " ", nm)
  trimws(nm)
}

metabolite_label_exact <- function(x, digits_mass = 2, digits_rt = 2) {
  p <- extract_metabolite_parts(x)
  nm <- clean_metabolite_name(x)

  mass_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p$mass))
  rt_num   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p$rt))

  mass_txt <- if (!is.na(mass_num)) format(round(mass_num, digits_mass), nsmall = digits_mass) else p$mass
  rt_txt   <- if (!is.na(rt_num))   format(round(rt_num, digits_rt),   nsmall = digits_rt)   else p$rt

  if (!is.na(mass_txt) && !is.na(rt_txt) && nzchar(mass_txt) && nzchar(rt_txt)) {
    paste0(nm, " [m/z ", mass_txt, ", RT ", rt_txt, "]")
  } else {
    nm
  }
}

make_hit_label <- function(protein, metabolite, width = 34) {
  met_lab <- metabolite_label_exact(metabolite)
  met_lab <- stringr::str_trunc(met_lab, width = width, side = "right")
  paste0(protein, "\n", met_lab)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Build plotting data
## ---------------------------------------------------------
sig_keys <- unique(paste(summary_stats_sig$protein, summary_stats_sig$metabolite, sep = "___"))

plot_df <- summary_stats %>%
  mutate(
    protein = as.character(protein),
    metabolite = as.character(metabolite),
    clean_met = vapply(metabolite, clean_metabolite_name, character(1)),
    exact_met_label = vapply(metabolite, metabolite_label_exact, character(1)),
    hit_label = mapply(make_hit_label, protein, metabolite, USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    recommended_hit = paste(protein, metabolite, sep = "___") %in% sig_keys,
    endpoint_score = abs(mean_estimate_train) + abs(mean_estimate_test)
  )

## optional safety filters
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(mean_estimate_train),
    is.finite(mean_estimate_test),
    is.finite(frequency_validated_direction)
  )

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Label data:
## label only recommended hits, but avoid repeated-looking labels
## keep the best row per protein + cleaned metabolite name
## ---------------------------------------------------------
label_df <- plot_df %>%
  filter(recommended_hit) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(endpoint_score),
    desc(frequency_validated_direction),
    desc(frequency_train),
    median_pval_train
  ) %>%
  distinct(protein, clean_met, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Plot
## ---------------------------------------------------------

cor_test <- cor.test(
  plot_df$mean_estimate_train,
  plot_df$mean_estimate_test,
  method = "pearson",
  use = "complete.obs"
)

cor_label <- paste0(
  "Pearson r = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 2),
  "\nP = ", signif(cor_test$p.value, 2)
)

p_train_test <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = mean_estimate_train, y = mean_estimate_test)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = frequency_validated_direction),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_df %>% filter(recommended_hit),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#F1D302",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.7,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = hit_label),
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black",
    box.padding = 0.40,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 121
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("#2c7fb8", "#7b3294", "#d7191c"),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    name = "Freq.\nvalidated"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Train vs Test Estimates – Recommended Hits Highlighted",
    x = "Mean interaction estimate (train)",
    y = "Mean interaction estimate (test)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95")
  )

print(p_train_test)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 7. Save plot
## ---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir_main, "train_vs_test_estimates_recommended_hits_clean.pdf"),
  plot = p_train_test,
  width = 11,
  height = 6.5
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir_main, "train_vs_test_estimates_recommended_hits_clean.png"),
  plot = p_train_test,
  width = 11,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 300
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 8. Save tables
## ---------------------------------------------------------
write.table(

  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(

)

write.table(

)

write.table(
  summary_stats_sig,

)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 9. Optional diagnostics for repeated metabolite names
## ---------------------------------------------------------
duplicate_like_labels <- plot_df %>%
  filter(recommended_hit) %>%
  count(protein, clean_met, sort = TRUE) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

write.table(
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Protein vs Metabolite dot plot
# ONLY POSITIVE interactions
# Size = strict validated frequency
# Colour = mean train estimate scaled to [0,1]
# Ordered so highest strict validated frequency is on the TOP
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(scales)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("summary_stats"))

required_cols <- c(
  "protein",
  "metabolite",
  "frequency_validated_direction",
  "frequency_validated_strict",
  "mean_estimate_train"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(summary_stats))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("summary_stats is missing required columns: ",
       paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
out_dir_dot <- "dotplot_positive_strict_scaled02"
dir.create(out_dir_dot, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
extract_metabolite_parts <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- iconv(x, to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(x, "_", fixed = TRUE))

  if (length(parts) >= 3) {
    list(
      name = paste(parts[1:(length(parts) - 2)], collapse = "_"),
      mass = parts[length(parts) - 1],
      rt   = parts[length(parts)]
    )
  } else {
    list(
      name = x,
      mass = NA_character_,
      rt   = NA_character_
    )
  }
}

clean_metabolite_name <- function(x) {
  p <- extract_metabolite_parts(x)
  nm <- p$name
  nm <- gsub("^X\\.*", "", nm)
  nm <- gsub("\\.", " ", nm)
  nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm)
  nm <- gsub("\\s+", " ", nm)
  trimws(nm)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Build plotting table
#    Keep only positive mean train estimates
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_df <- summary_stats_sig %>%
  mutate(
    protein = as.character(protein),
    metabolite = as.character(metabolite),
    metabolite_clean = vapply(metabolite, clean_metabolite_name, character(1)),
    freq_strict = as.numeric(frequency_validated_strict),
    freq_direction = as.numeric(frequency_validated_direction),
    effect_train = as.numeric(mean_estimate_train),
    effect_abs = abs(effect_train),
    score = freq_strict * effect_abs
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(freq_strict),
    is.finite(freq_direction),
    is.finite(effect_train),
    effect_train > 0
  )

if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
  stop("No positive interactions available after filtering.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Select top hits
# ---------------------------------------------------------
top_n <- 40

top_hits <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(
    desc(freq_strict),
    desc(freq_direction),
    desc(effect_abs)
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n)

if (nrow(top_hits) == 0) {
  stop("No top hits available for plotting.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Scale mean train estimate to [0,1]
#    This is the ACTUAL scaling step used in the plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (length(unique(top_hits$effect_train)) == 1) {
  top_hits$effect_scaled <- 1
} else {
  top_hits$effect_scaled <- scales::rescale(top_hits$effect_train, to = c(0, 1))
}

# optional check
print(summary(top_hits$effect_train))
print(summary(top_hits$effect_scaled))
print(range(top_hits$effect_scaled, na.rm = TRUE))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Order axes
#    Protein on Y: highest strict validated frequency at TOP
#    Metabolite on X: highest strict validated frequency at LEFT
# ---------------------------------------------------------
protein_order <- top_hits %>%
  group_by(protein) %>%
  summarise(
    best_freq_strict = max(freq_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_freq_direction = max(freq_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_effect = max(effect_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(best_freq_strict), desc(best_freq_direction), desc(best_effect)) %>%
  pull(protein)

met_order <- top_hits %>%
  group_by(metabolite_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    best_freq_strict = max(freq_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_freq_direction = max(freq_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_effect = max(effect_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(best_freq_strict), desc(best_freq_direction), desc(best_effect)) %>%
  pull(metabolite_clean)

top_hits <- top_hits %>%
  mutate(
    protein = factor(protein, levels = rev(protein_order)),
    metabolite_clean = factor(metabolite_clean, levels = met_order)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot
#    Size = strict validated frequency
#    Colour = scaled mean train estimate [0,1]
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_dot <- ggplot(
  top_hits,
  aes(x = metabolite_clean, y = protein)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = freq_strict,
      colour = effect_scaled
    ),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(3, 10),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    name = "Strict validated\nfrequency"
  ) +
  scale_colour_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#d7191c",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    name = "Scaled mean\nestimate\n(train)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Top Positive Protein–Metabolite Interactions (n = ", nrow(top_hits), ")"),
    subtitle = "Positive mean train estimates only; colour scaled from 0 to 1",
    x = "Metabolite",
    y = "Protein"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_dot)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir_dot, "dotplot_positive_strict_scaled01.pdf"),
  plot = p_dot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir_dot, "dotplot_positive_strict_scaled01.png"),
  plot = p_dot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

write.table(
  top_hits,
  file = file.path(out_dir_dot, "positive_hits_table_scaled01.txt"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nSaved to:\n", out_dir_dot, "\n")
cat("Main plot: dotplot_positive_strict_scaled01.pdf/png\n")
cat("Table: positive_hits_table_scaled01.txt\n")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------

out_dir_heat <- "dotplot_positive_strict_scaled02"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
extract_metabolite_parts <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- iconv(x, to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(x, "_", fixed = TRUE))

  if (length(parts) >= 3) {
    list(
      name = paste(parts[1:(length(parts) - 2)], collapse = "_"),
      mass = parts[length(parts) - 1],
      rt   = parts[length(parts)]
    )
  } else {
    list(
      name = x,
      mass = NA_character_,
      rt   = NA_character_
    )
  }
}

clean_metabolite_name <- function(x) {

  nm <- p$name
  nm <- gsub("^X\\.*", "", nm)
  nm <- gsub("\\.", " ", nm)
  nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm)
  nm <- gsub("\\s+", " ", nm)
  trimws(nm)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Build plotting table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_df <- summary_stats_sig %>%
  mutate(
    protein = as.character(protein),
    metabolite = as.character(metabolite),
    metabolite_clean = vapply(metabolite, clean_metabolite_name, character(1)),
    freq_direction = as.numeric(frequency_validated_direction),

  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(freq_direction),

  )

if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {

}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Choose top hits

top_n <- 40

top_hits <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(
    desc(freq_strict),

  ) %>%

if (nrow(top_hits) == 0) {

}

# ---------------------------------------------------------

if (length(unique(top_hits$effect_train)) == 1) {

} else {

}

print(summary(top_hits$effect_train))
print(summary(top_hits$effect_scaled))
print(range(top_hits$effect_scaled, na.rm = TRUE))

# ---------------------------------------------------------

protein_order <- top_hits %>%
  group_by(protein) %>%
  summarise(
    best_freq_strict = max(freq_strict, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) %>%

met_order <- top_hits %>%

p_heat <- ggplot(

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_heat)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir_heat, "heatmap_dotoverlay_strict_direction_trainscaled.pdf"),
  plot = p_heat,
  width = 13,
  height = 8
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir_heat, "heatmap_dotoverlay_strict_direction_trainscaled.png"),
  plot = p_heat,
  width = 13,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

write.table(
  top_hits,
  file = file.path(out_dir_heat, "heatmap_dotoverlay_top_hits_table.txt"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nSaved to:\n", out_dir_heat, "\n")
cat("Main plot: heatmap_dotoverlay_strict_direction_trainscaled.pdf/png\n")
cat("Table: heatmap_dotoverlay_top_hits_table.txt\n")
```
